We are seeking an experienced Product Owner to drive the development, positioning, and commercialization of innovative communication solutions for public safety and mission-critical environments.

The ideal candidate is a senior telecommunications professional with extensive experience in mobile network technologies and a strong understanding of the unique requirements of mission-critical communications. This role combines product management, value proposition development, stakeholder engagement, and support for strategic bids and RFP responses within the Belgian public safety sector.
Key responsibilities

• Define and manage the product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for mission-critical communication services

• Develop compelling value propositions that address the needs of public safety organizations, emergency services, and other critical communication users

• Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value and customer benefits

• Collaborate with technical, commercial, and regulatory stakeholders to ensure market-aligned product development

• Support business development activities by contributing to high-quality RFP and tender responses

• Monitor market trends, competitive developments, and emerging technologies in the mission-critical communications landscape

• Drive the adoption of innovative mobile network capabilities, including advanced 4G and 5G services, network slicing, QoS mechanisms, and mission-critical communication solutions

• Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams and external stakeholders on mission-critical communication strategies and technologies

• Minimum 10 years of experience in the telecommunications industry, with a strong focus on product management and service development

• 
Deep knowledge of mobile network technologies, including:

4G / LTE

5G

Quality of Service (QoS)

Network Slicing

Mcx (Mission Critical Services)

MVNO environments

• Proven experience in developing product strategies, business cases, and value propositions

• Strong understanding of mission-critical communications and the public safety ecosystem

• Experience supporting or leading responses to complex public procurement processes and RFPs

• Ability to engage with both technical and executive-level audiences

• Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills

• 
Trilingual (ENG/DUTCH/French), at least English + French or Dutch

jobs.occupation: Category CE/C Driver | National Routes | Turnhout
jobs.description:
Are you a motivated Category CE/C Driver who enjoys being on the road and values variety in their work? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you! For a stable and growing transport company based in Turnhout, we are looking for an enthusiastic Category CE/C Driver to carry out national deliveries throughout Belgium. 
What will you do? As a Category CE or C Driver, you play a key role in the company's daily operations and ensure that customers receive their deliveries safely, correctly, and on time. Your responsibilities include: Delivering goods to customers safely and punctually 
Loading and unloading your vehicle according to company guidelines 
Checking goods and accompanying transport documents Maintaining direct contact with customers and representing the company in a professional manner 
Managing your route planning with flexibility and efficiency
What do we expect from you? You hold a valid Category CE or C driving licence You possess a valid Code 95 certificate 
You have a good command of English You are customer-oriented and professional in your approach

Are you a strong planner with a passion for technical operations? Working closely with our Maintenance, Supply Chain, and CAMO teams, you will transform maintenance requirements into practical and efficient work plans while continuously optimizing maintenance scheduling and resource allocation
Your responsibilities include:
• 
Planning, preparing, monitoring, and finalizing maintenance work packages.

• 
Assigning and tracking manpower requirements for maintenance tasks.

• 
Coordinating tool and equipment availability with relevant stakeholders.

• 
Ensuring all required spare parts and consumables are available on time.

• 
Monitoring actual versus planned man-hours and optimizing future planning accordingly.

• 
Tracking the status of helicopters, parts availability, and maintenance progress.

• 
Collaborating closely with engineers, chief engineers, maintenance planning, Supply Chain, and CAMO.

• 
Identifying planning bottlenecks and proposing process improvements.

• 
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives and maintaining accurate planning data.

• 
Contributing to a culture of safety, quality, and information security.

We are looking for a proactive and organized professional who enjoys solving complex planning challenges in a technical environment.
You have:
• 
A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

• 
2 to 3 years of experience in a technical, engineering, maintenance, or production environment.

• 
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

• 
Knowledge of French or another language is considered an asset.
You are:
• 
Highly organized with strong planning and coordination skills.

• 
Analytical and able to maintain a clear overview of multiple priorities.

• 
Comfortable working under pressure and meeting deadlines.

• 
Proactive, solution-oriented, and focused on continuous improvement.

• 
A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating across departments.

• 
Responsible, reliable, and eager to take ownership of your work.

• 
Interested in aviation, maintenance operations, and ongoing professional development.

DRIVER'S LICENSE C

Working in this company means working in a respectful environment where great bonding between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

For our client in Roeselare we are looking for a packer of food products. As a packer you are responsible for

 
• 
Packing different types of food products in a fresh environment (5à10°).

 
• 
You work in a team and therefore, together with the line manager, you make sure that the right products are packed in the right way.

 
• 
You choose in which regime you are available: 7:45 to 15:30 OR 15:45 to 23:30.

We are looking for a motivated candidate who knows how to get things done.

 
• 
You have already gained initial experience as a packaging worker in the food industry.

 
• 
It is important that you work accurately and have an eye for quality.

 
• 
You can work well in a team.

 
• 
You are flexible about the work and the hours.

 
• 
You speak good Dutch, English or French.

As a Pistol Painter, you'll play a crucial role in our vibrant team, ensuring every vehicle part meets our high-quality standards. • Eye for detail and color precision
• Experience as a repairer/painter
• Fluent in English
• Strong communication skills and teamwork ability

As a Maintenance Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently on our production lines. jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst
jobs.description:
As a vehicle technician, you are responsible for the maintenance and repair of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles of all makes. You will work in a spacious, modern body shop known for its craftsmanship and customer focus. The workshop specializes in both conventional and electric/hybrid vehicles, so you'll work with the latest automotive technologies.

On a typical day, you’ll independently carry out both minor and major maintenance services. You diagnose technical issues using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and perform mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs. Quality is key, and you ensure every vehicle leaves the workshop in top condition.

Are you a precise, self-reliant technician with a passion for cars? Apply now and become part of a dedicated team. Together, you’ll ensure satisfied customers and vehicles in perfect working order.

• Diploma in automotive technology at secondary education level or equivalent through experience

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a car technician

• Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and systems

• Able to work independently and accurately

• Proficient in English, both spoken and written

• Holder of a valid category B driver’s license

• Passion for vehicles and new technologies

Are you ready to take the next step in your career as a Technical Operator? As a vital member of our team, you'll work with cutting-edge machinery to produce high-quality steel profiles. You'll become an expert in operating our state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring that production runs smoothly and efficiently.

Every day, you'll engage with complex and simple finishing machines including conventional and CNC-controlled systems like sawing machines, drilling machines, and laser cutters. Your keen attention to detail and commitment to quality will ensure that every component meets our high standards.

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Knowledge of pneumatics and ability to install tubes and test movements

• Passion for technology and a team-oriented mindset

You'll keep delivery on track, surface dependencies early, and make sure priorities stay aligned across the programme.
What makes you the right fit

You understand IAM concepts well enough to engage with the team on substance: Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes, access recertification, access requests and application onboarding. You can challenge estimates, spot cross-team dependencies and anticipate risks.

• PSM or CSM certification

• Several years of experience as a Scrum Master in IT security or IAM programmes

• Experience in the banking or financial services sector is a strong advantage

• Exposure to SailPoint (IdentityIQ / Identitynow) is a strong plus

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English

• Nice to have: Experience taking on project lead responsibilities on infrastructure topics

To succeed in this role, you combine strong technical expertise with a service-oriented mindset. You have

jobs.occupation: CE Dump Truck Driver – Reliable Shuttle Between Sint-Katelijne-Waver & Hemiksem
jobs.description:
As a CE Dump Truck Driver (m/f/x), you are responsible for daily shuttle transport between Sint-Katelijne-Waver and Hemiksem. You operate a tipper truck to ensure goods are loaded, transported, and unloaded safely and correctly. Safety, punctuality, and a strong sense of responsibility are key in this role.

Your average workday begins with a vehicle inspection. You load materials, depart on time to the next location, and ensure smooth delivery. In addition to transporting goods, you handle transport documents correctly and comply with driving and rest time regulations. You keep your truck clean and well-maintained. After your shift, you may take the truck home.

Can you see yourself driving between these two fixed sites for a reliable client? Apply today and secure a stable, well-paid job with future prospects!

• You have a valid CE driving license

• You are up to date with Code 95 and medical examination

• Experience with tipper transport is a plus, not a must

• You are punctual, reliable, and able to work independently

• You have a strong sense of responsibility

• You speak and understand basic Dutch or English

• You have at least lower secondary education

• 0 to 5 years of experience is sufficient

• Both junior and medior profiles are welcome

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specializing in storage, transport and handling of goods. Based in the city of Ghent in Belgium, the company has offices around the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in logistics and supply chain management. Katoen Natie Ghent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has strong ties with the local community. The company has taken several initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

 

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.
• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.
• You speak fluent English and Dutch
• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.
• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.
• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.
• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.
• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.
